jobs.p1_hook: tall vertical picture: a small laundry corner. One front-loading washing machine stands on the floor in the right half, big and whole, with one large round door whose glass is empty and blank: plain pale glass, nothing visible inside, about half the machine width. The main character sits on the floor on the left, leaning its back against the side of the machine, lazily scrolling one phone held up in both front paws, relaxed half-closed eyes, a careless little smile; its tail lies on the floor beside it with its flame. LAYOUT: the machine and the cat together fill the lower two thirds, the machine slightly taller than the sitting cat; the round glass is fully visible and not covered by the cat; the phone screen is blank; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p2_smell: tall vertical picture: the main character has just opened the round door of a front-loading washing machine and recoils with a disgusted shocked face, one front paw pressed over its nose, eyes squeezed, ears back, fur bristling; one damp grey crumpled shirt hangs out of the open drum; three wavy green stink lines rise from the drum. LAYOUT: the machine whole on the left, the cat whole on the right, both big, a small gap between them; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p3_call: tall vertical picture: the main character sits on the floor facing the viewer, smiling warmly and confidently, holding out one neatly folded fresh soft towel toward the viewer in both front paws like a friendly offer; its tail flame burns bright. LAYOUT: the cat big and whole in the lower middle, the towel close to the viewer; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p4_done: tall vertical picture: the main character walks away from a closed quiet washing machine toward the left, carefree, eyes closed, a satisfied smile, one paw brushing off the other as if the job is finished; above its head floats one round thought bubble with one big simple tick mark inside. The washing machine stands still on the right, door closed, its round glass empty and blank. LAYOUT: the cat whole in the left half mid-step, the machine whole on the right, both big; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p5_basin: tall vertical picture: the main character carefully puts one empty round plastic laundry basin right on the threshold of an open plain doorway, bending a little, a focused clever face; the doorway frame stands on the left. LAYOUT: the doorway frame tall on the left, the cat whole and big in the middle, the basin clear and whole on the threshold; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p6_trip: tall vertical picture: the main character comically trips over one empty round plastic laundry basin standing on a doorway threshold: mid-stumble, one hind paw caught in the basin, front paws flung up, wide bright eyes and an open-mouthed 'aha!' look of sudden remembering; its tail flame flares up bright. LAYOUT: the cat big and whole in the middle, the basin under its hind paw, the doorway frame at the edge; no letters or numbers anywhere.
